accountConsent.method: device code through the packaged GitHub CLI on the device (`gh auth login --web`), completed by the account owner at github.com/login/device
accountConsent.scopeRefresh: a second device code (`gh auth refresh -s delete_repo`) added repository deletion for the temporary write target
accountConsent.firstAttempt: the first device code expired before consent and `gh auth login` exited with failure; the flow was re-run with the new code

realRead.equivalence: the device text plus one trailing newline hashes to the host raw content hash; the provider trims the trailing newline
realRead.network: the device contacted github.com directly; no host proxy or TLS fixture was used

realWrite.setup: repository, probe branch, probe.txt commit and pull request #1 were created with the device GitHub credential
realWrite.cleanup: the repository was deleted with the device credential and a follow-up API read returned HTTP 404

tooling: the shipped Inspector drove the device GitHub CLI runner during the consent and cleanup steps and captured the full output; the Inspector and Forge bundles were disabled and the profile files were restored byte-identically afterwards

verified: real account consent through the device GitHub CLI
real-account pull request read with byte-equivalent file content
real-account review and squash merge on a temporary private repository
merge result and merged content verified through the GitHub API
temporary repository deleted and absence verified
temporary bundles disabled and profile restored byte-identically
pending: writes to the project's own repositories were not performed; the acceptance used a disposable private repository
